title: Quarterly signal synthesis and decision-lane playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Synthesize signals from product telemetry, usage cohorts, commercial feedback, and reliability incidents to produce a single-page decision pack and a playbook of decision lanes for the upcoming quarterly stakeholder forum. Goal: give execs 3 clear investment lanes (No-regrets, Optimize-for-cost, Experimental) with recommended asks, measurable success criteria, and a roll-forward contingency plan. Deliverables: 1) 8-slide decision pack for the leadership forum, 2) a decision-lane playbook (2 pages) that maps owner, metrics, and fallback policy, and 3) an action tracker mapped into Linear for all follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Leadership deck finalized and reviewed by PM and Eng leads
Decision-lane playbook published to Confluence and linked in the deck
All follow-up actions created as Linear sub-tickets with owners and due dates
Stakeholder sign-off from CEO office and Head of Eng
updates: 2025-02-12: Ticket created after cross-functional sync. Initial signal collection template posted to Confluence.

2025-02-19: Eng feedback: No-regrets lane requires two kernel-level changes and a safety rollback plan; estimate for kernel work ~3 sprints. Assigned ENG-3421 to track.
2025-02-21: Design reviewed deck visuals and suggested simplified visualization for economic tradeoffs; DES provided a micro-pattern library for comparison charts.
2025-02-24: Draft deck prepared; sync scheduled with CFO office on 2025-02-27 to validate ask sizes and runway impact.
2025-02-26: Pre-read deck posted to Drive; added a short appendix with reliability incident excerpts to justify fallback lanes. Requesting final review and sign-off by 2025-03-03.
decision_log: 2025-02-17: Adopted three-lane framing to keep asks crisp and mutually exclusive.

2025-02-19: Trade-off: accelerate kernel work vs. expand Dedicated capacity. Decided to propose hybrid ask: small reserved spend + commit to kernel roadmap contingent on measurable improvements in p99 latency.
2025-02-24: Decided to include a hard fallback policy that pins route to older model variant for high-risk customers during rollout windows.

Create sub-issues for kernel delivery (ENG-3421), console dashboard updates (ENG-3499), and playbook copy (DES-128)
